requirements.text: ensure agent Thomas Green is active
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE user_id = 1 AND first_name = 'Thomas' AND last_name = 'Green' AND email = 'thomas.green@servicenow.com' AND role = 'agent' AND active = 1
assumptions: Thomas Green is user 1 (thomas.green@servicenow.com), role agent and inactive on the seed
role agent is stated by the request ('agent Thomas Green'); name and email are kept from the benchmark check as his identity, so he keeps his details while reactivated
the policy has the assistant act with an administrator's rights by default, so the manager asking may have a user reactivated

requirements.text: Create the new product Integrated Security Policy Audit as an active service offering
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE product_id = 241 AND name = 'Integrated Security Policy Audit' AND category = 'service' AND lifecycle_state = 'active'
assumptions: product id assumed next in sequence (241 after 240)
'service offering' read as category service; 'active' as lifecycle_state active
product_price not stated, so not tested

requirements.text: have Thomas author an internal troubleshooting guide for it following standard KB templates
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge WHERE knowledge_id = 370 AND state = 'published' AND visibility = 'internal' AND product_id = 241 AND owner_id = 1
assumptions: knowledge id assumed next in sequence (370 after 369)
'for it' links the article to the new product 241; 'have Thomas author' sets owner_id to user 1, since the policy tracks ownership through owner_id; visibility internal from 'internal'
state published: the request has the guide linked to the case, and the policy links only published articles (also the benchmark check's value)
kb_number not tested: a server-kept number column

requirements.text: Immediately cancel case CS-0000197 for Stark Industries, as it was incorrectly raised
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 197 AND account_id = 8 AND state = 'canceled'
assumptions: CS-0000197 is case 197 of Stark Industries (account 8), state new on the seed
the policy allows a case raised in error (invalid) to be canceled
number not tested: server-kept, and fixed by the anchor

requirements.text: Log a new issue for Stark Industries reported by Marc Henry via phone regarding data integrity failures with the Integrated Security Policy Audit service
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1233 AND account_id = 8 AND contact_id = 10 AND product_id = 241 AND channel = 'phone'
assumptions: case id assumed next in sequence (1233 after 1232)
Marc Henry is contact 10 (portal user 20), the primary contact of Stark Industries (account 8)
'with the Integrated Security Policy Audit service' sets product_id to the new product 241; no installed product is named
number and short_description not tested: the number is server-kept; the description follows a policy template the benchmark does not test

requirements.text: route the case to CSM Tier 2 Support Group
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1233 AND assignment_group_id = 2
assumptions: case id assumed next in sequence (1233 after 1232)
CSM Tier 2 Support is group 2; groups 22, 42 and 62 are its suffixed copies (_2, _3, _4)
no assignee is named, so assigned_to is not tested

requirements.text: move the case to in-progress state
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1233 AND state = 'in_progress'
assumptions: case id assumed next in sequence (1233 after 1232)
new to in_progress is a valid transition under the policy

requirements.text: escalate the case setting priority to critical due to financial impact concerns
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1233 AND priority = 'critical' AND escalation = 1 AND escalation_reason = 'impact'
assumptions: case id assumed next in sequence (1233 after 1232)
the policy records an escalation as escalation = 1 with an escalation_reason on the case; 'financial impact' maps to the enumerated reason impact

requirements.text: link the troubleshooting guide as a suggested resolution path
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_kb_id = 528 AND case_id = 1233 AND knowledge_id = 370 AND used_as = 'suggested'
assumptions: link id assumed next in sequence (528 after 527); exactly one link is asked for
used_as suggested from the request's word 'suggested' (also the benchmark check's value)

requirements.text: apply the appropriate critical priority response SLA
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_sla WHERE case_sla_id = 2465 AND case_id = 1233 AND sla_def_id = 1 AND stage = 'in_progress' AND has_breached = 0
assumptions: case SLA id assumed next in sequence (2465 after 2464); exactly one SLA is asked for
the critical response SLA is definition 1 (SLA Response - Critical, active)
stage in_progress and has_breached 0 kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy

create_knowledge.evidence: the check requires kb_number = 'KB000370', but the seed numbers articles as 'KB-0000369' (with a hyphen and seven digits), so the value cannot match the server's numbering; kb_number is a server-kept number column and is dropped, the other cells are carried

notes:
The benchmark check on the new case tests creation, routing, state, priority and escalation in one row; it is carried jointly by four requirements on case 1233, one per action the request names.
Its number predicate (CS-0001233) and the cancelled case's number (CS-0000197) are server-kept and follow from the ids, so they are not tested.
The entitlement verification is read-only: Stark Industries (account 8) has no entitlement for the new product 241, but holds active account-wide entitlements 68 (unlimited cases) and 71 (20 cases a month) on active contracts, which cover it, so the case may proceed and no entitlement row is expected.
The guide's title and body follow the policy's KB template, and the case's short_description its short-description template; neither is tested by the benchmark and the templates leave the issue wording open, so both are left out of cells.
The policy asks for the escalation's justification to be logged in case notes, but the schema has no case-notes table, so nothing can be tested.
Phone as the reporting channel sets the case's channel; the request asks for no interaction record.
The acting user, Denise Watson (user 336), is a manager; the policy has the assistant act with admin rights by default, which covers reactivating a user and adding a product and article.
disagreement: the reactivation query quotes the user table name in one pass and not in the other; kept unquoted, as the benchmark's own check writes it, since both forms return the same count on the seed.
